standard: IEEE 1800-2023 6.21: the variables declared in a static task are static, so every call of the task, including calls that overlap in time, reads and writes one variable; 13.3.1: the items of a static task are shared by all its uses. In count, `int seen;` therefore holds the value the call at 1 ns writes when the call from time 0 reads it at 2 ns, giving a = 2.
method: The shared case runs unchanged in verify-sv-verilator, verify-sv-icarus and verify-sv-xezim; the reduced source below runs without the adapters (verilator --binary --timing, iverilog -g2012 -s Top, xezim -s Top, and the Celox sv_tests driver in simulation mode). count2 declares the same local with an explicit `static` and is the control.
